prompts.Aim:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down action game animation sprite sheet. Reference image: ONLY the purple cybernetic boss character design and eight facing directions; do not reproduce background, text or diagram labels. Match that same hulking purple plated reptilian cyborg, black mechanical shoulder cannon with orange muzzle, luminous green circular chest core, cyan energy blade on its anatomical right forearm, bulky claw feet and other free claw. Keep anatomy, scale, palette, clothing and gear consistent in EVERY frame.
Primary request: draw genuinely different body/arm/leg poses for one animation, a clean regular grid EXACTLY 6 columns by 8 rows, 48 complete isolated full-body sprites on a truly transparent alpha background. Canvas 1536x2048. Each cell equal 256x256. Center each boss within its cell, feet near cell's bottom, consistent core registration. Leave at least 20px transparent margin inside every cell. No missing cells, overlap, cropping or stray particles. NO TEXT NO NUMBERS NO LABELS NO borders. Sharp pixel art matching reference, nearest-neighbor-looking hard pixel edges, rich controlled purple shading, bright crisp green core and cyan blade; NO blur, glow haze, soft edges, anti-aliasing or ground shadow.
Directions ROW 1 faces SOUTH toward viewer, ROW 2 SOUTH EAST, ROW 3 EAST profile, ROW 4 NORTH EAST three-quarter back, ROW 5 NORTH back view, ROW 6 NORTH WEST three-quarter back, ROW 7 WEST profile, ROW 8 SOUTH WEST. Keep this top-down camera consistent. Each row has the same motion sequence in its own direction. Do not rotate front sprites flat; draw appropriate anatomical back/profile views. Transparent background and empty space between sprites. Animation: SHOULDER CANNON AIM AND RECOIL. Column 1 neutral weapon ready, column 2 crouched planted feet and braced shoulder winding up, column 3 shoulder cannon aimed forward in the row's facing direction, claw arm extended to balance, column 4 powerful recoil with upper torso leaning backward from the facing direction and legs braced, column 5 cycling mechanism body settling and claw pulling inward, column 6 ready aim again with cannon pointed forward. Cannon is existing shoulder-mounted cannon, not a new handheld gun. Body should visibly lean and arms change pose; full body stays in cell. No muzzle flash or bullets; these effects will be added separately.
